regime_context: The policy regime is stagflationary: Warsh's Fed is prioritizing the inflation mandate while Bessent's Treasury suppresses front-end yields through bill issuance and dealer reforms, so the consensus 'coordinated easy Fed' narrative diverges from a setup that holds easing as post-midterm, inflation-gated optionality while the Iran re-escalation inflates oil and pushes hike probabilities above 70%.
regime_context_zh: 当前政策体制呈滞胀特征：沃什领导的美联储优先通胀目标，而贝森特执掌的财政部通过短债发行和交易商改革压低前端收益率。因此市场共识中“美联储协调放松”的叙事与实际情况相背离——实际的布局是把降息当作中期选举后、且以通胀门槛为前提的期权，而伊朗局势再度升级推升油价，使加息概率升至70%以上。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: With September hike probability >70% and real 10-year near 2.29%, the Fed's strict-inflation posture plus Treasury's bill-heavy issuance suppresses long-end prices; the market is more hawkish than the dot plot, and Warsh's refusal to signal cuts leaves TLT exposed to yield repricing into the post-midterm pivot window.
theses.thesis_zh: 9月加息概率超过70%，10年期实际利率接近2.29%。美联储严格盯住通胀的姿态叠加财政部以短债为主的发行策略，压制长端价格；市场比点阵图更偏鹰派，而沃什拒绝释放降息信号使TLT在中期选举后的政策转向窗口之前面临收益率重定价风险。
evidence: Fed path gap: market 3.96% vs Fed dot 3.8%, market more hawkish than the Fed
Treasury bill-heavy issuance and buyback strategy for yield suppression
theses.dissent: The labor crack (June payrolls +57k vs ~115k expected) could force a data-driven September pivot, and the front-end easing already underway flows into duration bids that lift TLT even with a hawkish Fed.
theses.dissent_zh: 劳动力市场疲弱（6月非农仅+5.7万，预期约11.5万）可能迫使美联储在9月转向数据驱动的宽松路径，而前端收益率走低带来的资金流入久期资产，即使美联储保持鹰派也可能推升TLT。

falsifier.text: TLT beats SPY by 5% before the check-by date on a confirmed September cut or the labor crack widening
falsifier.text_zh: 在截止日期前，9月确认降息或劳动力市场进一步恶化，TLT 跑赢 SPY 5%

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse and US strikes re-primed the oil shock, with Brent spiking to ~$80 intraday; energy was already Q1 2026's top ETF-inflow sector and the rotation is re-confirmed by the conflict, while XLE's track record shows two recent hits on the same thesis.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火协议破裂及美军空袭重新点燃了石油冲击，布伦特盘中飙升至约80美元；能源板块本就是2026年一季度ETF流入最多的板块，冲突进一步确认了资金轮动，而XLE在该主题上已连续两次命中。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026
Recent track record: XLE overweight hit twice (realized +0.0473 and +0.0253)
Oil upside-skewed on headlines, re-escalation spike realized
theses.dissent: A genuine ceasefire re-take or de-escalation headline would unwind the risk premium quickly, and the stagflationary demand hit from hot PCE plus a hawkish Fed could cap oil demand expectations.
theses.dissent_zh: 若出现真正的停火重启或局势缓和的消息，风险溢价将迅速消退；同时，PCE火热叠加美联储偏鹰带来的滞胀性需求冲击也可能限制油价的上涨预期。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 3% before the check-by date on a credible ceasefire or Hormuz de-escalation confirmation
falsifier.text_zh: 在截止日期前，出现可信的停火或霍尔木兹局势缓和确认，XLE 跑输 SPY 3%

theses.subject: ITA
theses.thesis: The NATO defense spending super-cycle is structural and high-confidence, with the Iran conflict re-priming the defense bid regardless of oil's two-sidedness; defense primes, missile defense, and munitions flow benefit from budget commitments that are insulated from tariff-truce and ceasefire headline noise.
theses.thesis_zh: 北约国防开支的超级周期是结构性且高确定性的，伊朗冲突重新强化了军工板块的买盘逻辑，且不受油价双向波动影响；国防主承包商、导弹防御和弹药生产商受益于预算承诺，对关税休战和停火等消息噪音具有隔离性。
evidence: NATO/Defense theater: structural spending super-cycle marked FACT (budget/NATO)
Defense bid persists regardless per Iran theater read
Proxies ITA, XAR, PPA, SHLD listed as targeted/high-confidence
theses.dissent: Defense stocks have likely already priced the super-cycle, and with the market pricing a hike-majority Fed, valuation compression could hit longer-duration defense capex names even as budgets rise.
theses.dissent_zh: 军工股可能已经充分定价了这一超级周期，且市场正在计入美联储加息概率过半，即使预算增长，估值压缩也可能冲击久期较长的国防资本开支类个股。

falsifier.text: ITA lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date on a broad risk-off with defense underperforming despite ongoing conflicts
falsifier.text_zh: 在截止日期前，尽管冲突持续，但整体避险情绪下军工板块跑输大盘，ITA 落后 SPY 5%

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for ITA)

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The advanced-chip tariff regime transitions from Section 122 to Section 301 replacement at ~12.5%, preserving the onshoring bid for domestic semiconductors; the AI-compute capex cycle funds fabs, and the SCOTUS strike-down did not unwind the tariff-protection premium, so SMH's structural tailwind persists if the Section 301 handoff completes cleanly.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税体制正从第122条过渡到约12.5%的第301条替代税率，维持了对国内半导体的本土化生产激励；AI算力资本开支周期支撑晶圆厂建设，最高法院的否决并未消除关税保护溢价，因此若301条衔接顺利完成，SMH的结构性顺风将延续。
evidence: China tech war theater: Section 122 expiring July 24, Section 301 replacement ~12.5% pending
SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind tariff-protection premium
Domestic semiconductors/fabs listed as FACT mechanism with proxies SMH, SOXX
theses.dissent: SMH already missed badly on the same thesis in June (realized -0.1578), and a hot-PCE stagflationary regime plus higher front-end rates compresses high-multiple semiconductor valuations before the tariff handoff is confirmed.
theses.dissent_zh: SMH 在6月曾基于同一逻辑大幅失误（实际收益-0.1578），而且PCE火热带来的滞胀环境叠加前端利率抬升，会在关税衔接确认前压缩高估值半导体板块。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date, repeating the June miss as the Section 301 handoff stalls or chip valuations compress
falsifier.text_zh: 在截止日期前，若第301条衔接受阻或芯片板块估值承压，SMH 再度落后 SPY 5%，重演6月的失误

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: The dealer-intermediation reform and Treasury central-clearing expansion channel more Treasury market activity through banks, while a steepening front-end under bill-heavy issuance supports net interest margins; regional banks in KBE benefit from the de-facto funding alignment between Treasury and a hike-holding Fed.
theses.thesis_zh: 交易商中介改革和财政部中央清算扩容将更多国债市场活动通过银行渠道进行，而短债为主的发行结构下的前端陡峭化利好净息差；KBE中的区域银行受益于财政部与维持加息态度的美联储之间事实上的资金利率对齐。
evidence: Open prediction: SEC advances Treasury central-clearing expansion
Financials/dealer banks listed as FACT mechanism with proxies XLF, KBE
theses.dissent: Regional banks carry commercial real estate and credit-cycle exposure that can dominate rate spreads in a stagflationary regime, and rate-hike expectations above 70% could pressure deposit costs faster than loan yields.
theses.dissent_zh: 区域银行持有商业地产和信用周期敞口，在滞胀环境下可能主导信用利差走势；加息概率超过70%的预期可能使存款成本上升快于贷款收益率。

falsifier.text: KBE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date on a regional-bank credit event or no eSLR/clearing progress
falsifier.text_zh: 在截止日期前，出现区域银行信用事件或eSLR/清算改革无进展，KBE 落后 SPY 5%
